componentEvidence.reactDevelopmentFixtureLimitation: Actual TSX development fixture, not immutable graph evidence; final application cases separately exercise production React bundles.

readonlyPlatformEvidence.deferredNativeExplanation: 18 observations are the same nine declared dynamic controls at two widths. Final actual click/tap tests verify one LQ owner/popup, blur, names, options and zero input/change on open/close.
readonlyPlatformEvidence.reuseLimit: 112 GET observations were collected on 475a46c. The final shared Field width/size and typed searchable repair is covered by 17 immutable component and 22 actual page scenarios; the complete 112 GET matrix was not repeated.

historicalRuns.interpretation: Intermediate 5727 graph: 16 passed; four test assumptions failed (old task trigger and family-off Selection expectation), fixed in the QA spec.
Previous 475 graph: 15 passed; three startup ECONNREFUSED cases had not reached the app, two touch fixture selectors needed More-menu/React filterbar scoping.
Three desktop scenarios passed after bounded health readiness and fixture fixes.
Two touch scenarios passed after public More-menu and scoped React selectors.
Two QA failures used a nonexistent popup id; actual LQ popup was open.
All nine first-activation controls passed on both widths; each test then failed because the synthetic profile had no identity row. Final test clicks Add identity to create an unsaved draft.

limitations: Chromium desktop and touch emulation only, not Safari/Firefox/physical low-end device FPS.
Only synthetic SQLite data and identities; server guards dotenv, PostgreSQL and external sockets. No production data connection used for tests.
Readonly GET visibility and declarations do not prove all domain states; pending/unknown remain unchanged.
Native sync POST conflict is fulfilled with a synthetic HTTP 409; no external academic synchronization runs.
No schema migration was introduced by this UI/planned-projection task. Release and native gate are owned by the parent task.

release.backgroundTaskBoundary: Aggregate remains false for existing historical failures and queue; before and after summaries are equal. This release does not claim to repair unrelated background tasks.
